title: Family Caregiver Value by State: Home Health and Personal Care Aide Wages (BLS-only release)
description:
State-by-state hourly and annual pay for home health and personal care aides (SOC 31-1120), BLS OEWS May 2025: the wage benchmark Family Estate Guide uses to value unpaid family caregiving.

Live page: https://familyestateguide.com/estate-planning-data/family-caregiver-value-by-state/. Published by Family Estate Guide.

Rights review: Removed all AARP Public Policy Institute 'Valuing the Invaluable 2026' data (Table A1): aarp_smaller_state_flag, aarp_caregivers, aarp_care_hours_millions, aarp_value_millions, aarp_value_per_hour. AARP's report is copyrighted and not released under an open license. Removed columns computed from AARP figures: care_hours_per_caregiver_year, care_hours_per_caregiver_week, value_per_caregiver_at_aide_median, total_value_at_aide_median_millions, aarp_rate_minus_aide_median, rank_value_per_caregiver, rank_total_value. Result: the headline 'value of family caregiving' figures on the live page are not reproduced here; only the public-domain BLS wage inputs are.

Not legal, tax, financial or medical advice. Figures are estimates with sampling error; legal rules change. Verify anything important with the original source or a qualified professional.
